thread:
Nina: Posting follow-up from Cust-Atlas Dedicated isolation postmortem. Root causes: VPC route flap + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion. Short action list below.

Sam: Can we get owners and short ETAs? Also: is this tied to control-plane deploys?

Diego: Pattern match: yes. We've seen two similar incidents where peering route churn coincided with heavy short-lived client connections. Conntrack overflow shows up in kernel logs during the flap.

Priya: Repro notes: when we replayed session churn while inducing a route flap, SYNs get dropped once conntrack table > ~65%. Logs: ```
Mar 08 11:02:14 fw kernel: nf_conntrack: table full
Mar 08 11:02:14 fw custom-fw: conntrack overflow
```

Sam: Owners proposed:
- Sam: peering fallback & monitoring (short-term)
- Diego: on-prem reproducibility, sizing guide (mid)
- Priya: customer comms + SLA impact (short)
- Nina: program owner + exec update (long)

Nina: Short-term mitigations (today): enable regional fallback for Cust-Atlas (ETA 3h), push tcp_keepalive_time=15s on gateway (ETA 1h), notify customer (Priya ETA 30m).

Diego: Mid/long actions: add conntrack usage alert at 75% (ETA 4 days), publish NAT sizing doc for Dedicated customers (ETA 7 days), schedule monthly peering stress tests (ETA 30 days).

DeployBot: Created tickets: INC-53100, REM-53101, CS-53102. https://jira.redwood/INC-53100

Priya: Draft to customer: "We've applied a temporary routing fallback and are working on a permanent fix. We'll share a detailed timeline within 7 business days." Approve?

Sam: Approve. Also add cross-customer analysis: correlate BGP flaps with control-plane deploy windows for past 180 days. Owner: Sam. ETA 2025-02-01.

Diego: Repro command to add to runbook: ```
for i in {1..300}; do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 50 | grep conntrack
```

Nina: Good. Please attach logs to REM-53101 and update Jira owners. We'll review in the new "peering cadence" slot next week. If blocked, escalate on #eng-oncall.

Priya: ack. Adding runbook note: "Validate conntrack headroom before Dedicated cutover."

Sam: I'll coordinate with Eng-Platform about a short deploy-damping window for active peering customers.
